instantiate_from_config: instantiate a Python class from a config dict with a target module path and kwargs
get_obj_from_str: get a class or function object from a dotted string like 'mymodule.MyClass'
save_videos_grid: save a batch of video tensors as a grid video file at a given path and fps
setup_logger: setup a colored logging logger with optional file output for distributed training ranks
format_time: format an elapsed time in seconds into a human-readable string with days hours and seconds
